A '''xenopathologist''' was a type of [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]]. [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]] studied [[xenopathology]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], though he worked as a combat surgeon after gaining his degree.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The occupation of xenopathologist was first mentioned in the entry for Archiban Kimble in the [[2012]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', a reference guide for [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The word "xenopathologist" is a combination of the prefix "xeno," meaning alien<ref name="Xeno">{{WebCite|url=http://www.dictionary.com/browse/xeno-|text=Xeno- &#124; Define Xeno- at Dictionary.com|quote=a combining form meaning "alien," "strange," "guest," used in the formation of compound words|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com]]|archivedate=20171211064354}}</ref> and "pathologist," someone who studies diseases.<ref name="Pathology">{{WebCite|url=http://dictionary.reference.com/browse/pathology|text=Pathology &#124; Define Pathology at Dictionary.com|quote=the science or the study of the origin, nature, and course of diseases|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com]]|archivedate=20171205032530}}</ref>
